title: Credits
intro: VocabX stands on other people's work: dictionaries, sentence collections, fonts and open-source libraries. Here they are.

translations.title: Translations
translations.text: Translation suggestions in the word form are automatic translations by Google Translate. They may be inaccurate.

sentences.title: Example sentences
sentences.text: Sentences come from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org) under the CC BY 2.0 FR licence. Each sentence credits its author.

definitions.title: Definitions and translations

art.title: Artwork

libraries.title: Open-source libraries
